en: A multi-view colored postcard composed of nine small images depicting landmarks of the city of Graz. Captions in German identify each view: the town hall on a busy square (Rathaus), a grand university building (Universität), the clock tower on a hill (Uhrturm), Kaiser Josef-Platz with a central building and market square, a panoramic view of the new hospital complex (Neues Krankenhaus), an urban square with prominent church tower (Bismarckplatz), a river view of the city looking north (Graz gegen Norden), a lake with boats and trees (Hilnteich/Hilmteich), and the funicular/railway up the castle hill (Schlossbergbahn).
